structured_output.title: New ingress-shim annotation option available
structured_output.content: The environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with the ingress-shim controller deployed (evidenced by installed cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate CRD and Deployment manifests). In v1.18.0, a new optional flag `--extra-certificate-annotations` enables copying specific annotation keys from Ingress-like objects to resulting Certificate objects. This new capability is now available post-upgrade. Inspect your cert-manager deployment controller arguments and Ingress → Certificate workflows to determine if you need to configure this annotation-mapping behavior.
